title: The Manta's universal Time AI: one Soar drive for Redline I1-I4, grown from every Manta genome - with the AI nose lead ON
goal: The lead-on twin of redline-manta-time: the same search, the same seeds and genomes, with the pilot-side AI nose lead switched on in the model (nose_lead 2.5; Tools/Build/ai_nose_lead.py, the model of AIPilot.NoseLeadGain from PR #1786, which the game ships at 0). Redline's model already flies the fleet nose lag (manta_redline_sim), so only the lead is added. Garrett's plan (REGATTA_BALANCE_PLAN.md, the direction since 2026-11-06) judges every hull and every course on AIs that do not overshoot ring mouths, so each hull's drive is searched again with the lead on and compared with its lead-off twin on the same courses: the lead-on winner is the drive proposed for the day Yash turns the switch on. Run by hand until Compute is back (Shombith paused it 2026-11-06): /mnt/project-files/regatta-training/local_run.py, two independent restarts (labels B, C). Parent goal: The Manta's universal Time AI (Docs/AI_SYSTEM/AI_PLAN.md step time-arcade): ONE Soar drive (MantaSoarAITuningSO's BoostStickBand and YawsteryStickBand) that races all four Redline intensities well. Its first generation is every Manta Time genome (the executor's shipped bands 0.35 / 0.75 and MantaSoarAITuning_Regatta's 0.975 / 0.975, learned from people's Regatta races; MantaSoarAITuning_Redline joins when the AI learning sweep writes it) and mutations of each; the loss is the four intensities' scores together (mean + 0.5 x the worst), raced on the Redline simulator (Tools/Build/manta_redline_sim.py: the shipped five-lap course on the Soar-only ladder of 2026-11-04 and its Time crystals, the gate aim, AIPilot stick, skill throttle and orbit break-off, the Soar triggers, the hull's turn law and AI nose lag; on Regatta's I1 course it laps in 28 s against the editor's Hard AI Mantas' 23-28 s). Measured 2026-11-04 on this job's 4 courses an intensity: the shipped bands score 21.98 and finish 16 of 16 (median I1 186 / I2 176 / I3 193 / I4 538 s), the Regatta genome 25.05, a first local search's 0.118 / 0.83 20.46 (I4 491 s). It replaces drive-manta-redline, whose model was about 3x too fast and whose best bands (1.0 / 0.63) score 49.28 here and finish none of I3-I4. The bands are a small lever; the AI nose lag is the big one (AI_PLAN.md decision 7). The winner is the Manta that Regatta is searched against (step time-arena-course).
asked_by: Yash 2026-11-03, the AI owner: "Let's make Manta AI training". Garrett's plan (AI_PLAN.md rules 2 and 3) sets its shape.
area_owner: Yash (vessel AI, Redline and the Manta's AI)
promote: Only after Yash turns AIPilot.NoseLeadGain on (PR #1786) and its editor check passes; then as the parent's rule, against the parent's winner raced WITH the lead: A PROPOSAL for the AI owner (Yash), any of the core four approving: race the team's best against the shipped bands and every genome on 12 FRESH courses per intensity (seedbase 1001); keep it only if it finishes as many as the best of them on every intensity and its composite is lower. Then it becomes MantaSoarAITuning_Redline (MantaSoarAITuningSO.LoadForMode), written with the learner's writer (Tools/Build/learn_drives_from_flights.py's asset writer), never by hand. The editor check goes in Docs/UNITY_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md (AI Mantas race Redline at I1-I4).
